title: Cap door warns when a cell's verify omits a direct-edge suite from the impact registry
action: Per E1, at cap time cross-check the cell's verify against the impact registry and WARN LOUDLY -- never refuse. For each path in cell.files that exists in scripts/impact-registry.json, run queryRegistry(registry, cell.files, {level:1}) and name on stderr every returned suite that does not appear in cell.verify. Reuse queryRegistry and normalizeQueryPath from scripts/impact_registry.mjs:449-486; write no new derivation logic. Follow the existing ratioWarning shape at lib/cells.mjs:2003 -- same channel, same non-blocking semantics. Scope to level:1 direct edges only: a transitive sweep would name so many suites the warning becomes noise nobody reads. The warning must NAME the missing suites, because a warning that names its fix is actionable and one that says 'check your verify' is not. A missing or unreadable registry is a silent skip, never a throw -- this sits on the path of every cap. The motivating evidence: cells vd-1 and vd-2 edited packages/bee/lib/state.mjs in the same slice; the registry names packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs as a direct edge of that file; vd-1 listed it in its verify and vd-2 did not, and the resulting export-census regression cost a whole repair cell.

truths: Capping a cell whose verify omits a direct-edge suite prints a warning naming that suite and still caps
A missing, unreadable or malformed impact registry skips the check silently and never blocks a cap
No cap that succeeded before this change now fails

artifacts.substantive: registry cross-check emitting a named warning, non-blocking

key_links: the check reuses queryRegistry from scripts/impact_registry.mjs rather than reimplementing it
prohibitions: No refusal path added to the cap door
No transitive registry query -- level:1 only
No throw on a registry read failure

trace.outcome: Cap door now cross-checks cell.verify against the impact registry (level:1 direct edges) via queryRegistry/normalizeQueryPath and warns loudly on stderr for any missing suite, never refusing; missing/malformed registry is a silent skip. packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs and .bee/bin/lib/cells.mjs stay byte-identical.
